title: AWS Config and conformance packs: compliance as code

videos.script: CloudTrail tells you what was asked. AWS Config tells you what things are, and what they were last Tuesday, before somebody changed them. {{what}} You will start a recorder and watch it discover the shop's buckets, each with a history of configuration items. {{recorder}} Then rules. A managed rule judges every bucket against a sentence, such as: has an owner tag. The lab's moto stores the rules and judges nothing, so you will write the judge yourself. {{rules}} A short program that does what a custom rule does: read each bucket's latest configuration item, never the bucket itself, and decide. Two pass, two fail, and the dangerous one is the one with an owner. {{custom}} Then a conformance pack, the rules as one file, and a warning about fixing things automatically. {{pack}} And the bill, including the account where Config became one of the largest lines, because something changed all day. {{bill}}
